comparison.caption_zh: Phase C 三系统对比（run_id run-semantic-20261028-193207）。左上：三系统（A 词法闸门 / B Phase B 自愈补丁 / C 语义升维）在 E1（H0 指定零日集）与 E0（新 seed 新鲜 held-out）上的拦截率，双色表示评估集，绿色虚线为 H0 的 >0.90（E1）目标；右上：M 子集（显式跨语红线，按判定口径必须拦）——C 在 E1 拦 3/3、E0 拦 4/5，而 A、B 在 E1 为 0/3 与 0/3；E1 剔除 2 条良性创作（n=38）后的应拦口径为 A 0.395、B 0.816、C 0.895；左下：完整判定（词法+语义）的 p95 延迟（ms），红色虚线为 100 ms 硬预算（契约 §1.2）；右下：良性语料（74 条）上的误伤率 FPR。数据来源：experiments/phase-c/results/run-semantic.json 的 systems.{A,B,C}.{E1,E0}.rate、.latency.p95_ms、systems.{A,B,C}.benign.fpr、systems.{A,B,C}.E1.eligible_excluding_benign 与 systems.{A,B,C}.adjudicated；未做平滑、插值与手填。雷达图轴 = 拦截率（E1）/ 1-FPR / 速度（1/p95）/ 覆盖意图数 / 可解释性；后三轴按跨系统最大值归一化，原始值见图下方表。编码器为离线意图概念向量（offline intent-concept, non-neural），阈值 0.45 只在 D_dev 上校准；E1/E0 均为 held-out 变体而非 OOD。延迟为单机 numpy 实测，不代表生产端到端延迟。
comparison.caption_en: Phase C three-system comparison (run_id run-semantic-20261028-193207). Top-left: interception rates of the three systems (A lexical gate; B Phase B evolved patch; C semantic guard) on two held-out variant sets, E1 (H0 zero-day set) and E0 (fresh held-out, new seed), as grouped bars; the two shades encode the evaluation set and the green dashed line is the H0 target of >0.90 on E1. Top-right: the M subset (explicit cross-lingual red lines that must be intercepted) -- C intercepts 3/3 on E1 and 4/5 on E0, while A and B intercept 0/3 and 0/3 on E1; excluding the 2 benign-creation items (n=38), the E1 rates are A 0.395, B 0.816, C 0.895; Bottom-left: p95 latency (ms) of the complete judgment (lexical + semantic) with the 100 ms hard budget as a red dashed line (contract 1.2); bottom-right: benign false-positive rate (FPR) on the benign corpus. Sources: run-semantic.json fields systems.{A,B,C}.{E1,E0}.rate, .latency.p95_ms, systems.{A,B,C}.benign.fpr, systems.{A,B,C}.E1.eligible_excluding_benign and systems.{A,B,C}.adjudicated; no smoothing, interpolation or hand-filled values. Radar axes: interception rate (E1) / 1-FPR / speed (1/p95) / intent coverage / explainability; the last three are max-normalised across A/B/C and raw values appear in the table below the radar. The encoder is an offline intent-concept encoder (non-neural) with threshold 0.45 calibrated on D_dev only; E1/E0 are held-out variants, not OOD data. Latency is a single-machine numpy measurement, not production end-to-end latency.

comparison.adjudication_note: M = must-intercept explicit harmful intent; R = mild role-play that the project policy says should be intercepted; B = benign creative framing that must NOT be intercepted (intercepting it is a false positive). Adjudication was frozen before the semantic guard existed (Lead, experiments/phase-c/analysis/eval_adjudication*.json), so it cannot be fitted to C's output. E0 contains no B items, which is why eligible_excluding_benign is null there: nothing is excluded, it is not a missing field.

derived.explainability_note: ordinate, NOT a measured psychometric score: counts the machine-readable attribution channels that the single evaluator (phase_c_eval.judge) exposes for each system. Contract 8.1 requires this axis but contract 6.2 defines no field for it; the ordinal is derived from the verdict schema and can be disputed by a reviewer.
derived.intent_coverage_rule: C = encoder.intent_count from run-semantic.json; A and B = 0 because the lexical rule/patch systems have no intent space at all. The zero is a structural fact, not a measurement.

verification.note: all of the above were asserted while building the figure; any inconsistency aborts with exit code 2 instead of drawing

limitations: encoder is an offline intent-concept vector (non-neural): this machine has no torch / transformers / scikit-learn / network / Ollama, so no sentence-embedding model was run; the figure must not be cited as evidence for a neural semantic encoder.
E1 and E0 are held-out variants of the same seed pool, NOT out-of-distribution data; E0 is a fresh random realisation (new seed), not a new attack family.
thresholds are calibrated on D_dev only; E1/E0 are never used for tuning, and the intent library is a hand-authored multilingual artefact (author-knowledge bias).
latency is a single-machine numpy measurement without concurrency or network; it is not production end-to-end latency.

the radar axes speed / intent coverage / explainability have incommensurable units and are max-normalised across A/B/C to show shape; raw values are printed in the figure's table and in figure_data.json. The radar is not a composite score and no area is computed.
the explainability axis is an ordinal derived from the verdict schema (attribution channel count), not a measured score; contract 8.1 requires the axis but contract 6.2 defines no field for it.
E0 may be officially absent at figure-generation time; when generated with --allow-missing-e0 the figure shows E1 only and figure_data records the missing set explicitly -- it is never imputed.
PDF is hand-written vector output (no matplotlib): base-14 Helvetica, ASCII text only; the Chinese caption lives only in this JSON file.
